title: Round matchup
description: The game this round trades: the two teams and the sharp pregame line, captured when the round opened. Reference data for the round rather than a reading to watch.

home_team.label: Home
home_team.description: The home side; the book quotes its win probability.

away_team.label: Away
away_team.description: The away side; its price is the complement of the home price.

pregame_home_prob.label: Pregame home win
pregame_home_prob.description: The sharp line's home win probability when the round opened. The model uses it as the prior all game.
